# Pellucid renewal debrief

**Date:** March 5, 2026  
**Attendees:** Bettina Kroll, June Osei-Lark, me

## Call summary
- Pellucid Harbor Logistics renewed Pemberline Dock at 150 seats, at $1,950 per seat per year.
- Next renewal: Feb 28, 2027.
- The discussion focused on morning gate congestion and dispatchers moving appointments between dock doors during shift handover.
- Pellucid requested a clearer way to distinguish rescheduled arrivals from new bookings in the daily dock report. Door 6 was the example: two dispatchers interpreted the same moved appointment differently.

## Action items
- I will send the renewal recap and request an anonymized copy of the morning dispatch report.
- June will prepare the contract handoff.
- Bettina will review the report example with me before we submit the product feedback.
